automatedEvidence: Computational Projects uses an ordered pipeline with tool annotations and evidence terminals.
Laboratory Research uses a specimen-to-assay bench and explicit prototype boundary.
Data Stories uses an analytical signal sheet and non-interactive publication status.
All three structures become a continuous single-column reading order below 48rem.
All visual relationships have the exact same identifier set and order as adjacent semantic tables.
Two unspecified roles and one verified team-led contribution are visible as text.
Three figures are lazy, asynchronously decoded, intrinsically sized, and locally recoverable.
Three research documents are native user-initiated links; unrelated future-unit documents are absent.
Reduced-motion, narrow-table, target-size, local overflow, and token-driven theme rules are present.
Five bodies are finished and five later bodies retain the unchanged temporary fallback.
